title: Set the related cut-off number on a private copy

proofs.run: WHOOSH_RIG_HIDDEN=1 sh scripts/launch-one.sh <bundle> -- --rig-hidden sh -c 'WHOOSH_SOCKET_DIR="$D" python3 checks/ownercopy-related.py' (the real engine on a private copy of the owner's mail, counts and closeness figures only; the copy is deleted by the run)
proofs.pass: (?s)(?=.*^PICK: )(?=.*^FLOOR: 0\.70 \| made-up queries marking a mail 0 of 12 \| topic queries with at least one 12 of 16)(?=.*private copy deleted: yes)

notes: Runs of 14 Nov 2026 on keep-main180 (the measure reads the engine, it does not depend on the floor being built): run 1 and 2, 8 topic and 2 made-up queries, cut-offs 1.0 to 5.0; run 3, 16 topic and 12 made-up queries with the closeness floors 0.64 to 0.74. The copy holds 310 mails in scope. The first rule (the lowest cut-off at which at most one topic query is over RELATED_MAX and half mark a mail) picks 1.0 and is NOT adopted: it was written for a mailbox where the cap binds, and at 1.0 a search marks 33 to 54 of 310 mails; the made-up queries mark as many mails as the topics at every cut-off, which is why the lift alone cannot be the rule. The second rule, written in the file before run 3, picks the floor 0.70; RELATED_LIFT_MIN stays 2.0 with the counts in its row. Engine: core/crates/engine/src/search_cmd.rs related_of; test d2 in core/crates/engine/tests/engine_search_related.rs, seen red on broken copy 0 (10 passed, 1 failed) and green on the tree (11 passed). Test engine: Sources/CoreBridge/FixtureSearch.swift liftRelated and relatedCut. Spec: docs/SPEC.md A150 last cell; docs/lanes/rank.md last section.
